Dubai: Customs has fined actress Ranya Rao Rs 89 crore in a fresh order tied to gold moved out of Dubai.

The 399-page order finds Rao moved 113kg of gold from Dubai to Bengaluru, including the 14.8kg caught at the airport that led to her arrest. It sits on the DRI's 2025 case: Rao and three others were fined Rs 270 crore over 127kg the same route. She has not responded publicly.

دبي: فرضت الجمارك الهندية غرامة جديدة بقيمة 89 كرور روبية على الممثلة رانيا راو في قضية تهريب ذهب من دبي.
